name: Local model served by vLLM
description: Serves an open-weight model (NVIDIA Nemotron by default) with vLLM on the app's GPU: a pinned vLLM in /opt/vllm, a model catalog with GPU fit and pinned revisions, a model store that can live on a bucket mount, and the scripts that start and validate the server. Debian-based images on x86_64 with an NVIDIA driver (580 or newer for this vLLM release).

username.description: Username of the container user. The server runs as this user at start-up (start-vllm.sh).

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user: where the model store, caches and log live (APP_USER_HOME at run time).
